WITH sales_by_item AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk, st.s_state,
           SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_qty,
           COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_qty,
           SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price,
           COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1999) AS dd
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics
          WHERE cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary') AS cd
      ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (SELECT s_store_sk, s_state FROM store WHERE s_state = 'TN') AS st
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, st.s_state
),
preagg AS (
    SELECT i.i_item_id, sb.s_state,
           SUM(sb.sum_qty) AS sum_qty,
           SUM(sb.cnt_qty) AS cnt_qty,
           SUM(sb.sum_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           SUM(sb.cnt_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(sb.sum_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           SUM(sb.cnt_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(sb.sum_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price,
           SUM(sb.cnt_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price
    FROM sales_by_item sb
    JOIN item i ON sb.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id, sb.s_state
    ORDER BY i.i_item_id, sb.s_state
    LIMIT 100
)
SELECT i_item_id, s_state, grouping(s_state) AS g_state,
       SUM(sum_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_qty), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(sum_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(sum_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM preagg
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
